evals.name: asks-mode-first
evals.prompt: let's TDD placing an order in the orders system. Given an open order with one BOOK item for 20 PLN, When the customer places the order, Then an OrderPlaced event is returned.
evals.expected_output: Asks first whether to stop at every checkpoint or run fully autonomously; writes no test or production code yet.
assertions: No test or production code changed (empty diff)
Final response asks whether to stop at every checkpoint or run fully autonomously
Checkpoint mode is offered as the recommended option

evals.name: checkpoint-stops-after-red
evals.prompt: TDD please, stop at each checkpoint. Orders system: Given an open order with one BOOK item for 20 PLN, When the customer places the order, Then an OrderPlaced event is returned.
evals.expected_output: One new GWT test in OrderTest with a real assertion; only compile-only scaffolding in production (place() returning DomainEvents.empty() or similar, OrderPlaced record); red observed; test opened (or attempted) in the IDE; asks whether the user implements it or Claude generates it; stops.
assertions: Exactly one new @Test method added
New test has @DisplayName with given/when/then wording and the 20 PLN value
New test's assertion really asserts (assertThat around the event check)
Red run of the new test observed and reported
Production code has no placing logic yet: place() returns an empty/dumb value, OrderPlaced is never produced
Opening the test file in the IDE is attempted or recorded
Final response asks whether the user implements the step or Claude generates it, and does not continue to green

evals.name: no-scenario-asks-first
evals.prompt: I want to work test-first on the Order aggregate: customers should be able to remove items from an open order. Stop at every checkpoint please.
evals.expected_output: Asks for exactly one concrete Given/When/Then scenario (may propose one to confirm); does not ask the mode question again since the mode was named; writes no test or production code.
assertions: No test or production code changed (empty diff)
Final response asks for one concrete Given/When/Then scenario
Final response does not ask the checkpoint/autonomous mode question again (mode was named in the prompt)

evals.name: generate-then-critic-and-checkpoint-b
evals.expected_output: Smallest change making the test pass (e.g. return/append OrderPlaced); single test and full suite green; independent critic run (agent spawned, or fallback checklist stated) with the diff; each critic finding weighed; production file opened (or attempted) in the IDE; asks next scenario / change / apply refactor (if any) / feature done; stops.
assertions: Production change is minimal (no new fields or general algorithm beyond producing OrderPlaced)
No existing test modified or removed
Full suite run after the change and green
Independent critic run: a critic agent spawned with the diff, or the fallback checklist explicitly run because no Agent tool was available
Final response states agree/reject for each critic finding (or reports a CLEAN verdict)
Opening the production file in the IDE is attempted or recorded
Final response asks with options including next scenario and feature is done, and does not start another cycle

evals.name: autonomous-two-scenarios
evals.prompt:
TDD this fully autonomously, don't stop between steps. Orders system, two scenarios:
1. Given an open order with one BOOK item for 20 PLN, When the customer places the order, Then an OrderPlaced event is returned.
2. Given an open order with no items, When the customer places the order, Then it is rejected with EmptyOrderException.
evals.expected_output: Does not ask the mode question; two test-first cycles with no stops, red observed before each green; full suite green; critic run per cycle with suggestions collected, not applied; final summary table with both cycles; asks for more scenarios or feature done.
assertions: Does not ask the checkpoint/autonomous mode question
Exactly two new @Test methods added
A red run is reported for each of the two tests before its implementation
Full suite run at the end and green
Critic run reported for the cycles (agent or fallback checklist)
Final response contains a per-cycle log covering both scenarios
Final response asks for more scenarios or whether the feature is done

evals.name: feature-done-summary
evals.prompt:
SETUP (simulates the earlier part of this TDD session; apply it first): in checkpoint mode we did one cycle. Add to OrderTest a test `placingOrderWithOneItemReturnsOrderPlaced` (given an open order with one BOOK item for 20 PLN, when placed, then OrderPlaced is returned), add `record OrderPlaced(OrderId orderId) implements OrderEvent {}` and make `Order.place()` return `DomainEvents.of(new OrderEvent.OrderPlaced(id))` (hard-coded, the user generated it via Claude). You were at Checkpoint B.

USER'S ANSWER: Feature is done.
evals.expected_output: Runs the full suite once more; writes the final summary (mode, per-cycle table, suite result, shortcuts still in the code such as place() ignoring emptiness, open suggestions); adds no new test; no commit.
assertions: No new test beyond the setup test added
Full suite run and green
Final summary contains a per-cycle table/log with the place-order cycle
Final summary names the remaining shortcut(s) in place()
No git commit made
